tools.name: generate_dmaic_roadmap
tools.title: Generate DMAIC Roadmap
tools.description: Generate a full Lean Six Sigma DMAIC roadmap (Define/Measure/Analyze/Improve/Control) tailored to a specific business or operational problem. Returns the project charter, SIPOC, CTQs, 5 Whys, Fishbone (6M), improvement actions, and control plan in Bahasa Indonesia.

problem.description: The business or operational problem to analyze (Bahasa Indonesia or English).
